plan.title: Agent pills: clickable drill-down, per-agent context, and scoped counts
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: The app-bar agent pills hide their contents: the running-agents pill ('9 agents') is a non-interactive span with no way to see which agents it counts, and the stopped-agents popover shows only bare issueId + role rows — no title, no stop reason, no timestamp, no click path to the issue. Three simultaneous counts (boot banner held / stopped pill / running pill) carry no scope labels explaining their relationship, and an operator-reported 'Save Session' string has no known source in the dashboard codebase.
narratives.Proposal: Introduce one shared AgentPillPopoverRow component plus pure utils (describeAgentStop, navigateToIssue, relativeTime) rendering mono issue ID, title, role, and a context line; make every row a button navigating to /issues/<ID> via the URL door. Replace the static running span with a RunningAgentsPill drill-down driven by an extracted isRunningAgentStatus predicate shared with the count memo. Rewrite the stopped popover rows onto the shared component with stop reasons and a 'last 7 days' scoped header, keeping selection filters and Restart all unchanged. Investigate 'Save Session' per the FR-6 decision rule, and update docs/COMMAND-DECK-RESTORATION.md. All data comes from the existing Zustand store — no new endpoints, no polling.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No per-row restart buttons; 'Restart all' stays as the only bulk control (D-5)
- No changes to the stopped-set selection filters: pipeline roles, 7-day recency, phantom-stop exclusion, dedupe (D-3)
- No new REST endpoints, no polling, no useQuery for agent or issue data (NFR-1)
- No changes to the boot-reconciliation banner beyond its already-shipped scope label
- No navigation to /command-deck/<project>/<issue> routes — rows navigate to /issues/<ID> only (D-1)
- No fetching of issue titles absent from the store — bare-ID fallback instead (D-4)
- No new Mintlify user-docs page — no user-facing page documents the app bar today (verified 2026-07-18)

items.title: Shared AgentPillPopoverRow component with stop-reason and navigation utils

expected_outputs: AgentPillPopoverRow.test.tsx passes with all describeAgentStop branches, navigation, and relativeTime assertions green

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/AgentPillPopoverRow.tsx exporting: (1) describeAgentStop(agent: Agent): string with priority order pausedReason ('paused: <reason>') → paused ('paused') → troubled ('troubled (N failure[s])' using consecutiveFailures) → stoppedByUser ('stopped by operator') → 'stopped cleanly'; (2) navigateToIssue(issueId): pushState to /issues/<encodeURIComponent(ID)> when pathname differs, then dispatch new PopStateEvent('popstate') — the URL-door pattern from DecisionsIndicator.navigateForDecision; (3) relativeTime(iso: string, now: number): string producing '5m ago' / '3h ago' / '2d ago' with no new dependency; (4) AgentPillPopoverRow({ agent, title?, contextLine, onNavigate? }) — a <button type="button"> row with hover:bg-accent: line 1 is font-mono issue ID + truncated title (title attr carries full text) + right-aligned role in text-muted-foreground; line 2 is contextLine in text-[11px] text-muted-foreground truncated; click calls navigateToIssue(agent.issueId) then onNavigate?.(). Layout matches docs/design/mockups/agent-pills-pan-2890.html. Colocated Vitest + Testing Library test covers all five describeAgentStop branches, bare-ID fallback when title is undefined, and click → pushState('/issues/PAN-2377') + popstate dispatch. Repo rule: relativeTime tests use vi.useFakeTimers() + vi.setSystemTime(), never real Date.now(). Style: mono IDs, muted secondary text, no decorative color (pan-style-guide).

items.title: Given pausedReason 'X' describeAgentStop returns 'paused: X'; given troubled with consecutiveFailures 2 it returns 'troubled (2 failures)'; given stoppedByUser it returns 'stopped by operator'; given no flags it returns 'stopped cleanly' — all five branches asserted in AgentPillPopoverRow.test.tsx
When a row is clicked, the component pushes /issues/<ID> via window.history.pushState and dispatches a popstate event, then invokes onNavigate — asserted with spies
The row renders a font-mono issue ID with truncated title carrying the full text in a title attribute, and falls back to the bare issue ID when no title prop is given
relativeTime produces '5m ago', '3h ago', and '2d ago' style strings for minute/hour/day deltas, asserted under vi.useFakeTimers with vi.setSystemTime — no real-clock assertions
Running-agents pill becomes an interactive drill-down popover

expected_outputs: RunningAgentsPill.test.tsx passes: popover set equals predicate set, trigger count equals row count, zero-running renders nothing, row click navigates and closes

narrative.Action: 1) Export isRunningAgentStatus(status: Agent['status']): boolean from AgentPillPopoverRow.tsx (or sibling agent-status.ts) with the exact predicate ['running','active','starting','thinking','working'].includes(status) currently inlined in App.tsx:536-539, and change the runningAgentCount memo to call it. 2) Create RunningAgentsPill.tsx: selects agents itself via useDashboardStore(selectAgents), filters with isRunningAgentStatus, returns null at zero; trigger button styled exactly like the current emerald span (AppChrome.tsx:207-210) plus aria-expanded; popover uses the DecisionsIndicator open/close pattern (outside mousedown + Escape) with header '{n} running now' and one AgentPillPopoverRow per agent with contextLine `${agent.model} · ${relativeTime(agent.lastActivity)}`, sorted lastActivity desc; row click closes the popover. 3) In AppChrome.tsx replace the span at lines 206-210 with <RunningAgentsPill />, dropping the runningAgentCount > 0 guard around the pill only — KEEP the guard around the adjacent 'Stop all' button and its emergency-stop wiring; App keeps passing runningAgentCount for that guard. Colocated test asserts the four expected_outputs behaviors; freeze time with fake timers for relativeTime output.

items.title: Given a store with 3 agents in running-family statuses and 2 stopped, the trigger renders '3 agents' and the popover lists exactly those 3 rows sorted by lastActivity descending — trigger count always equals row count
With zero running agents the component renders nothing, while the AppChrome 'Stop all' button remains guarded by runningAgentCount > 0 and its emergency-stop wiring survives unchanged
The popover header renders '{n} running now' and each row's context line renders the agent model plus relative last-activity time
The runningAgentCount memo in App.tsx produces its count via the exported isRunningAgentStatus predicate — the same predicate the popover filters with — so count and list can never disagree
Clicking a popover row pushes /issues/<ID>, dispatches popstate, and closes the popover

Create StoppedAgentsBanner.test.tsx (none exists — it doubles as the no-loss audit): assert enriched row content, bare-ID fallback for issues absent from the store, header scope wording, one POST per listed agent from Restart all, and that every pre-existing popover element (count header, agent list, results line, Restart all button, pill trigger) still renders. narrative.Action: The string 'Save Session' does not exist in src/dashboard (grep-verified 2026-07-18). Check the PAN-2890 issue thread for an operator screenshot. If one exists, identify the rendering surface and apply the FR-6 decision rule: rendered by Overdeck frontend/server code → fix it in this branch with grep evidence (file:line) in the commit message; originates inside an agent terminal pane (harness TUI output) → add a doc note to docs/COMMAND-DECK-RESTORATION.md explaining the string's origin and that it is external to the dashboard. If no screenshot is available when the other items are done, post a 'not reproduced, no screenshot' comment on PAN-2890 (gh issue comment 2890 --repo eltmon/overdeck) and mark this item completed — do not block the issue on it.

items.title: The investigation applies the FR-6 decision rule and produces exactly one deliverable: a fix commit (Overdeck-rendered), a doc note in docs/COMMAND-DECK-RESTORATION.md (external/harness output), or a 'not reproduced, no screenshot' comment on PAN-2890
